purpose: Validate natural NeuralRx failures and conventional recovery on request-specific noisy PUSCH data through a separate persistent MPS/CUDA-IPC endpoint.

endpoint.transport: same-device CUDA IPC with request-specific rx_slot/channel estimate and output LLR
endpoint.lifecycle: persistent for the entire timed epoch; teardown only after the final release

policy.recovery: run conventional full path on the same request when NeuralRx CRC/payload verification fails or the endpoint is disabled
policy.commit: one branch result is exposed per release

interpretation_limit: This gate establishes a physical separate-process S2 vertical slice and natural recovery utility. A statistical utility comparison against strong eager and conventional baselines remains a separate paired gate.
